theme: Last day abroad; the long way home starts tomorrow.
greeting: The Croatia trip is winding down, Dan — one open day in Cavtat before a pre-dawn start and the flights home. The things worth handling tonight are the ones that bite when you land in Tampa tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Airport taxi + early checkout in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: You leave around 5:15 AM tomorrow for LH4297 at 7:30 — arrange night/express checkout and the taxi with the hotel tonight, before boat-and-travel connectivity thins out.

needsAttention.title: Rental car waiting at Tampa
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA tomorrow at 3:55 PM and need the full-size SUV booked (Sept 20–Oct 5). Lock it now rather than facing a walk-up Sunday rate, jet-lagged.

needsAttention.title: St Pete beds for Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: The two nights between landing Sunday and the Tuesday Orlando pickup still aren't booked — the last open gap in the itinerary.

schedule.title: Cavtat, Croatia
schedule.detail: Last night at Remisens Hotel Epidaurus before the flights home

acts.line: The charter wrapped at noon — you're off the boat and settled in Cavtat.
A rare open stretch on the Adriatic before the long haul home.
An early night; checkout and the airport taxi come before 5:30 tomorrow.
